Definition: from G4696; to stain or soil (literally or figuratively):--defile, spot.
BiblicalUsage: To stain is what the tongue does and what the flesh does. The tongue defileth the whole body and setteth on fire the course of nature, and Jude tells believers to hate even the garment spotted by the flesh while they pull others out of the fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stain spreads from the tongue to the whole life, and the garment warns me how close sin clings.
